title: Needs a proper web version
body:
I’ve really enjoyed using Things 3 as my main task and reminder app. The interface is clean, simple, and very well designed, and I especially like how easy it is to organize tasks into areas, projects, and headings. It works really well for managing school homework, routines, packing lists, and other personal tasks without feeling cluttered.

One of my biggest frustrations is the lack of a proper web version. As a student, I sometimes need to use a school Chromebook, and being able to quickly add homework from a browser would make Things 3 much more useful. I currently have to put things into another app first and transfer them later, which adds unnecessary friction.

I’d also love more flexibility around web/Chromebook access and perhaps better cross-platform capture options in the future.

Overall, Things 3 is one of the best task managers I’ve used, and I really like its simplicity and organization. A web version would probably make it a 5-star app for me.

title: Sleek, clean look but still miss quite a few features
body:
This brings forth a few most important features:
- easy/quick entry, even for entry of to-do into area or project (due to its sidebar)
- clean look
- less actions/manoeuvres (due to its sidebar)
- multiple tagging for to-do instead of just one context like omnifocus
- comply to simplicity for task app
- link detection. Touch down and hold to open link. I link attachments like images and PDF files on clouds storage, but the bad side is that I have to maintain those attachments in the cloud storage later when to-do is done.

It's still lack of the following features:
- Note entry in Rich Text Format or at least able to attach some images separately within the app, as photo taking is essential and common in our daily activities. Day One allows 10 pictures per entry. OmniFocus permits copy and paste picture into note field. Since this is a to-do app, I suggest it's good to have at least 3 - 5 pictures attachments for each entry. The best is still having attachments stored within the app instead of links.

- Repetitive to-do feature needs some improvements, especially within project. I'll skip the details, since many have already mentioned.

- Smart filtering by tag(s) or text search at sidebar and good to have a header for groups of smart tags/filters.

- Sharing/export is text format only! Should there be more export formats? PDF with images? RTF? CSV? Excel?

Well, it's a very practical and great app overall. Excellent!
